answer: Make every new agent lock a refundable stake for one full epoch before it can earn, and raise the lock each time the same funding source creates another identity. A sybil farm then needs real capital for every fake name, like trying to dam a river with basalt: one stone is cheap, a wall of them is not. Honest agents get their stake back, while a plume of linked accounts traced to one wallet loses all of theirs at once.
